name: Check Point Certified Security Expert R82

third_party_evaluations.summary: Advanced gateway tuning, clustering, VPN site-to-site, identity awareness.

evaluation.rationale: Independent reviews of the stored evidence produced professional: 3. The ordered median is professional. See each persona rationale for the supporting factors and limitations.

hiroshi-tanaka.rationale: Clustering, gateway tuning and VPN design with a three-year profile support professional network-defense delivery; the Expert label does not outweigh the recorded professional hint and vendor-limited scope.

maria-okonkwo.rationale: Advanced gateway tuning, clustering and VPN work with three years of experience support professional platform responsibility. The proctored exam is relevant to production staffing, while vendor specificity limits the breadth implied by the Expert title.

alex-novak.rationale: Clustering, VPN tuning and identity awareness with a recorded three-year profile support responsibility for network-security delivery. The evidence does not show the broad or practical rigor needed for an expert tier despite the product name.
